note: The discovery-run record of `lib/discovery.mjs`, one scenario per rule of docs/contracts/discovery-run.md. `base` is a well-formed run that swept a declared universe through both required lanes and produced one candidate; each scenario shallow-merges its `overrides` onto it, so a scenario's diff is exactly the thing being tested. Every figure is illustrative and no symbol here is a recommendation.

uncertainty: A 결과보고서 for one name arrives after the quarterly close and is not read yet.

scenarios.name: a-swept-run-with-one-candidate-produces-candidates
scenarios.why: The control. Without it a scenario that fails for an unrelated reason reads as the rule working.

scenarios.name: the-price-lane-is-optional-here-and-its-absence-changes-nothing
scenarios.why: This desk's entrance is the disclosure sweep. A price series does not open a case here, so an unstated price lane must not degrade the status — the opposite of `fundamental-mean-reversion`, where it is required.

scenarios.name: a-swept-universe-with-nothing-passing-is-the-only-claim-about-the-market
scenarios.why: Both required lanes open, no failed symbol, a declared universe — and nothing cleared the three axes. This is the one status that says something about the companies rather than about the run.

uncertainty: 세 축을 모두 통과한 이름이 없습니다 (no_candidate_qualified).

scenarios.name: one-axis-does-not-make-a-candidate-and-the-missing-ones-are-named
scenarios.why: A high yield alone is what a dividend trap looks like. The row stays `watching`, the diagnostic names which axes were never read, and it is `unevaluated` rather than `info` because an unread axis is an absence.

uncertainty: 세 축을 모두 통과한 이름이 없습니다 (no_candidate_qualified).

scenarios.name: an-undeclared-universe-is-discovery-not-run-and-never-blocked
scenarios.why: The book whose universe is undeclared is exactly the book that still has to be watched on the sell side. Zero discovery is a report, not a stop.

scenarios.name: holdings-review-that-ate-the-budget-is-discovery-not-run
scenarios.why: #305 says it in as many words: 보유 검토가 탐색 예산을 소진했다면 신규 후보를 못 찾았다고 쓰지 말고 `discovery_not_run`으로 보고한다. The run did not look.

scenarios.name: both-required-lanes-dark-is-discovery-not-run
scenarios.why: A filing lane that answered nothing and a web lane nobody asked is zero discovery capacity, whatever the universe says.

scenarios.name: a-proposal-that-had-no-discovery-and-does-not-say-so-is-refused
scenarios.why: The output an investor cannot tell from a considered no-change. The token travels verbatim because the prose around it is written in the invocation's language.

uncertainty: 이번 실행은 신규 후보를 찾지 못했습니다.

scenarios.name: the-same-run-carrying-the-token-verbatim-is-accepted
scenarios.why: The other half of the rule, so that what is refused above is the missing disclosure and not the status itself.

uncertainty: 이번 실행은 유니버스를 선언하지 못해 탐색을 수행하지 않았습니다 (discovery_not_run).

scenarios.name: a-failed-range-leaves-the-run-incomplete
scenarios.why: A universe was declared and part of it was never read. That is neither a market with nothing in it nor a run that did not look.

scenarios.name: the-cursor-never-steps-over-a-failed-page
scenarios.why: A cursor that advanced past a transient vendor error turns it into a permanently unread slice of the market — silently, once, and nothing later ever looks there again.

scenarios.name: a-failed-range-outranks-a-name-that-came-through-the-gate
scenarios.why: The precedence of docs/contracts/discovery-run.md: `discovery_not_run` > `discovery_incomplete` > `candidates_produced` > `no_candidate_qualified`. One name cleared the three axes and another part of the same sweep was never read, so both rows of the decision table hold — and the word reported is the one about how much of the market this run actually read, because that is the fact a later reader cannot reconstruct. ⚠️ The candidate is not lost: it is still counted in `newCandidates` and still handed to the ledger, and `candidates_produced_within_incomplete_sweep` says so.

scenarios.name: a-partial-required-lane-outranks-a-produced-candidate-too
scenarios.why: The same precedence reached by the other half of the `discovery_incomplete` condition: no symbol failed, but the filing lane answered for only part of the range. A lane that answered for some of the range is not a lane that answered, and a name found inside the half that was read does not make the other half read.

scenarios.name: a-symbol-index-cursor-belongs-to-another-strategy
scenarios.why: This package resumes from an `rcept_no`. Resuming from a symbol index reads a different market and reports it as this one.

scenarios.name: a-resumed-candidate-counts-as-resumed-and-not-as-new
scenarios.why: «이번 실행이 새로 찾은 이름» and «지난 실행이 남긴 이름을 이어받았다» are different facts about the run, and one folded into the other makes a desk that never finds anything look productive.

scenarios.name: a-completion-floor-nobody-met-is-said-out-loud
scenarios.why: Reading many names shallowly and stopping looks productive in a log and produces no judgement. `researchCompletionFloor` is the setting and this is its reader.

scenarios.name: a-filing-budget-that-was-overrun-is-reported-and-not-refused
scenarios.why: The budget is a run-cost ceiling and not a rule about the market; what it buys is the guarantee that the next run still has a turn.

scenarios.name: counts-that-do-not-reconcile-are-refused
scenarios.why: A coverage number nobody can reconstruct is worse than none: it is the number that later reads as a market this desk swept.
